import math
import sys

def read_vector_data(v, n):
    for _ in range(n):
        val = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        v.append(val)

def compute_gcd_value(a, b):
    while a != 0:
        temp = b % a
        b = a
        a = temp
    return b

def main():
    epsilon = 1e-15
    numerator, denominator, max_limit = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    ratio = numerator / denominator
    n, d = numerator, denominator
    min_diff = 1e9

    for i in range(1, max_limit + 1):
        val = (numerator * i) / denominator
        floor_val = math.floor(val)
        ceil_val = math.ceil(val)
        rat_floor = floor_val / i
        rat_ceil = ceil_val / i
        diff_floor = abs(rat_floor - ratio)
        diff_ceil = abs(rat_ceil - ratio)

        if abs(diff_ceil - diff_floor) < epsilon:
            if diff_ceil < min_diff - epsilon:
                n = floor_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_ceil
        elif diff_ceil < diff_floor:
            if diff_ceil < min_diff - epsilon:
                n = ceil_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_ceil
        else:
            if diff_floor < min_diff - epsilon:
                n = floor_val
                d = i
                min_diff = diff_floor

    print(f"{n}/{d}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
